description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Grim Haruspex, adding {B}.
When Grim Haruspex dies, Yedora triggers, returning Grim Haruspex from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Grim Haruspex by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Grim Haruspex's morph ability by paying {B}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
